title: Lid
summary: A lid that snaps into a bin's stacking lip. Its top takes bins like a baseplate, so lidded bins still stack, or it can be a plain flat cover.

groups.title: Size
groups.help: Match the width and depth of the bin it covers, in 42 mm grid units. The lid fits any bin with a stacking lip, whatever its height.

groups.title: Snap fit
groups.help: Flexible clips in the sides of the plug click in under the bin's stacking lip, so the lid stays on when you carry or tip the bin. Press it on; pull firmly to take it off. Works with any bin that has a stacking lip.

groups.title: Top
groups.help: A stacking top has the same pockets as a baseplate, so bins of any size lock onto the lidded bin. A flat top is lower and easy to wipe.

groups.title: Grip
groups.help: A finger grip at the front edge lets you lift the lid even when bins stand right next to each other.

params.label: Width
params.help: Width along the front, in 42 mm grid units. Same as the bin's width.

params.label: Depth
params.help: Depth front to back, in 42 mm grid units. Same as the bin's depth.

params.label: Snap clips
params.help: One clip per grid square along the back and both sides. Turn it off for a lid that just drops in.

params.label: Clip strength
params.help: How far each hook reaches under the lip. More holds tighter and clicks harder; use less for stiff filaments like PLA, more for PETG. The clips click on bins with walls up to 2.2 mm thick.

params.label: Stacking top
params.help: Pockets like a baseplate's on top, so other bins sit on the lid and stay put. Turn it off for a flat lid.

params.label: Top thickness
params.help: Solid plate above the plug: the floor of the pockets on a stacking lid, or the whole top of a flat lid. Ribs under it every 21 mm keep 0.8 mm stiff. A flat lid with a finger grip needs at least 2.8 mm.

params.label: Hollow underside
params.help: Hollows the part that drops into the bin, leaving ribs and a rim. Less than half the plastic of a solid lid, and the top stays closed. It still prints plug-down without supports.

params.label: Magnet holes
params.help: Four magnet pockets in each pocket floor, lined up with the magnet holes in bins, so bins on top stay put.

params.label: Magnet diameter
params.help: 6.5 mm fits 6 x 2 mm magnets with glue clearance.

params.label: Magnet depth
params.help: Pocket depth from the floor of the stacking pockets.

params.label: Finger grip
params.help: A 45° undercut in the front edge for a fingertip. It prints without supports.

params.label: Grip width
params.help: Width of the finger grip, centred on the front edge.

checks.expr: stack or not grip or top_t >= 2.8
checks.message: A flat lid needs a top at least 2.8 mm thick for the finger grip: make the top thicker or turn the grip off.
The finger grip is wider than the lid's front edge allows: make it narrower.

checks.expr: not (light and magnets) or mag_h <= top_t - 0.6
checks.message: The magnet holes would break through into the hollow underside: make the top at least 0.6 mm thicker than the holes are deep, or turn Hollow underside off.

presets.name: Stacking
presets.help: Bins sit on top and lock to the grid

presets.name: Magnetic stacking
presets.help: Magnet pockets hold magnetic bins on top

presets.name: Flat
presets.help: Low and smooth, for kitchen and bathroom bins

presets.name: Dust cover
presets.help: Thinnest and lightest; lift it by the edges
